title: Samsung raises advanced foundry prices by up to 15% as AI demand fills its 4nm lines, report claims — Chinese customers accepting the largest hikes
raw_summary: Samsung raised prices on new orders across its 4nm, 5nm, and 8nm foundry processes in July, with increases reaching 15% for customers in China.
relevance_reason: 三星将4nm/5nm/8nm代工价格上调最高15%，AI需求推升产能利用率，对台积电定价策略也有参考意义。
cn_summary: 据报道，三星于今年7月上调4nm、5nm、8nm先进制程代工价格，最高涨幅达15%，其中中国客户涨幅最大。涨价背景为AI需求旺盛，三星4nm产线利用率接近满载，议价能力增强。这是头部晶圆厂在AI驱动下利用先进制程紧缺进行定价权变现的信号。
so_what: 1)跟踪三星4nm/5nm ASP变化与产能利用率，验证先进制程紧缺持续性；2)若三星涨价落地，关注台积电跟进定价的可能性；3)对国产算力链而言，三星涨价可能使部分中端订单分流至中芯国际。

title: China shifting massive AI data center complexes to rural provinces to tap surplus energy — ‘Eastern Data, Western Computing’ strategy has Chinese tech giants Huawei and Tencent building AI infrastructure Guizhou
raw_summary: Chinese tech giants are putting up data centers in rural Chinese provinces with zero resistance. The abundance of land and energy in these areas allowed infrastructure to easily be built with limited issues, although some experts still question how much development they can bring to these areas.
relevance_reason: 中国AI数据中心向贵州等能源富集省份迁移，华为腾讯加大西部布局，间接利好国产算力链。
